title: Arabizi (Franco): late order voucher, refused refund, support
turns: ahlan, ana 3ayza a3raf el order bta3y wasal fein
eh el 2ekhbar? ana mesh ba2dar astanna aktar men keda
el shahn 3adi bekam law talabt tany?
w law el order et2akhar kter, fi 7aga bet3awedony beha?
ena 3ayza el voucher bta3 el ta2khir lel order NS-20877
w el order el tany NS-20512 3ayza a3mel refund 3ashan mesh 3agebny
leh la2? ana estalemto men 3esherin yom bas
mashi, momken akalem 7ad men el support?
